description.value: Using goofy sound effects and randomly appearing hardlight obstacles, you can make even the most threatening beast into a joke. When you @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-actions.Item.o8lqmFexiwcaLpu3]{Set the Spotlight} on yourself, you can @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-actions.Item.ttL2TstfSqOyzCd2]{Cast a Role} to apply the comedy role to yourself as a free action. As long as you are in a spotlight with the comic role, you do not take the role's status penalty and can use Performance instead of Acrobatics to [[/act tumble-through skill=performance]] and you are not @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
